'''Drazhar''' is the most infamous of the [[Incubi]]. His position in the Incubus sect is '''Executioner''' as he is the champion of his order.{{Fn|3a}}

===Biography===
====Origin====
Drazhar was first encountered at the gates of the Great Shrine of the [[Incubi]]{{Fn|3a}} in [[Commorragh]]. He walked straight into the shrine, cutting his way through any guards who tried to stop him. When he reached the inner sanctum, Drazhar challenged the enthroned Hierarch  of the Shrine. The Hierarch stepped down from his throne into the duelling circle with Drazhar and took up a battle stance. The Hierarch's self-assured superiority soon evaporated when his challenger blurred into action. The duel took only a couple of minutes until it ended with Drazhar stepping over the Hierarch's dead body before making a small bow. He has since taken up the mantle of the Incubi's sacred executioner.{{Fn|3a}} He moves from Shrine to Shrine, leading Incubi to seek the greatest champions of foes and defeat them in single combat.{{Fn|8}}

No one knows Drazhar's true identity. There are no records of him in any Incubus shrines and no one had heard of him before he walked in to the Great Shrine. Even the name Drazhar is ceremonial, meaning ''Living Sword''.{{Fn|3a}} It is rumored he may be the fallen former [[Phoenix Lord]] of the [[Striking Scorpions]], [[Arhra]], but the truth of the matter is unknown.{{Fn|6}} Drazhar has never spoken in the presence of any patron or foe, so it is impossible to glean the truth from him.{{Fn|8}}

====Recent History====
Drazhar has since fallen under the employ of [[Asdrubael Vect]], who has put a bounty on the head of [[Yvraine]], prophet of the [[Ynnari]]. During the [[Raid on Saim-Hann]], he nearly slew Yvraine but was denied his prize by [[Jain Zar]] who allowed the prophet to escape.{{Fn|3b}} After that Drazhar feigned retreat through the [[Webway Portal]] and managed to trap his pursuers - Jain Zar and her [[Howling Banshee]]s. Ambushing them in [[Shaa-Dom]], Drazhar personally cut Jain Zar in two and then gave her armour to the [[Mandrake]]s of [[Aelindrach]] to ensure she never could be reborn again.{{Fn|4a}}

Sensing the death of a great [[Phoenix Lord]] and feeling guilt for it, Yvraine asked [[Ynnead]] to grant Zar another life. Upon learning that Jain Zar was resurrected, Drazhar set off to the lost [[Craftworld]] of [[Zandros]] to fight and kill her again. However, he did not foresee that Jain Zar was now imbued with Ynnead's energy of death. In an epic fight resembling the legendary fight on Zandros when Phoenix Lords [[Karandras]] and [[Arhra]] clashed in bloody battle, Drazhar was slain by Jain Zar.{{Fn|4a}}

After the battle, a [[Drukhari]] survivor ([[Klaivex]] [[Dara'kinia Thremense]]) found the armour and the mask of Drazhar and donned them, losing herself right after that. It may or may not mean that Drazhar is also one of the Phoenix Lords and hence was reborn.{{Fn|4b}}

===Reputation===
After Drazhar had invaded the Great Shrine of the [[Incubi]]{{Fn|3a}} and killed its Hierarch, gossip and rumors started to spread. Some say Drazhar is the [[Phoenix Lord|Fallen Phoenix]], [[Arhra]], even crediting Arhra with Drazhar's deeds{{Fn|}}, and that Drazhar's armour is filled with nothing but bone-dust.{{Fn|3b}} It is said that there is no challenger equal to Drazhar. All who challenged him have fallen under his blades. Yet Drazhar has shown no inclination to take up the position of Hierarch or even Klaivex. He is the Executioner, and exists only to kill; nothing more, nothing less.{{Cite this}}

Drazhar is one of the very few denizens of Commorragh who is widely admired. His deeds are often spoken about, particularly among those who managed to secure his services on a realspace raid. It is said he single-handily dispatched a trio of [[Custodian Guard]]s in close quarters and was able to out-match [[Jain Zar]] in sword ability.{{Fn|3a}}

===Equipment and Abilities===
Taller and more lithe than other Incubi, Drazhar is fast as lightning. He wears an ancient Incubus Warsuit, perhaps even the original Warsuit, which is significantly tougher than those worn by others of the sect. Drazhar uses [[demiklaives]] or '''disemboweller blades'''{{Fn|3b}} which can also be used by deadly Klaivex Incubi leaders.{{Fn|3с}}

Drecarth.wikitext:
{{BlackLegionPortal}}
'''Drecarth''', also known as '''Drecarth the Sightless''', was a [[Space Marine Captain|Captain]] of the [[Sons of Horus]]. Falling to Heresy with the rest of his legion, he left [[Maeleum]] during the [[Eye of Terror Slave Wars]] and eventually broke off from the Sons of Horus and formed his own warband, the [[Sons of the Eye]].{{Fn|1a}} He then led his Sons against a [[World Eater]]s warband under [[Voslok]]{{Fn|1b}}  in the [[Battle of the Keening Deep]]{{Fn|2}}. He claimed their fortress after personally slaying the Khornate warlord{{Fn|1b}} when Drecarth wrested Voslok's daemonic axe from his grip turning the evil weapon against its former master, winning the battle and finishing off the enemy warband.{{Fn|2}}

During the [[Sixth Black Crusade]], Drecarth agreed to an alliance with [[Abaddon the Despoiler]] and his [[Black Legion]]. During the siege of the [[Forge World]] of [[Arkreath]], the two forces fought side by side but after the battle was won Abaddon impaled Drecarth on his [[Power Claw]], assimilating the Sons of the Eye into his own forces.{{Fn|1a}}

Dremmond.wikitext:
{{TanithPortal}}
'''Dremmond''' was a [[Flamer|flame]]-[[trooper]] of the [[Tanith First and Only]] [[Imperial Guard Regiment|regiment]].{{Fn|1a}}{{Fn|2}}


==Biography==
In the closing stages of the [[Siege of Vervunhive]], Dremmond was one of thirty Tanith selected personally by [[Colonel-Commissar]] [[Ibram Gaunt]] to take part in [[Operation Heironymo]], the mission to infiltrate [[The Spike]] and assassinate [[Heritor Asphodel]].{{Fn|1b}}

Later, when the regiment was deployed on [[Phantine (Planet)|Phantine]], Dremmond was stationed aboard a [[drop-ship]] designated '''2K''' as part of the assault on [[Cirenholm]]. However, on the approach to the city, drop-ship 2K was hit by [[Blood Pact|enemy]] anti-air fire and brought down. The pilot was forced to make a crash-landing on the outside of Cirenholm's secondary dome; the ship made it to relatively secure ground thanks to the efforts of [[Imperial Guard Commander|Commander]] [[Bree Jagdea]] of the [[Phantine Fighter Corps]] (who had survived being shot down herself earlier in the battle) but, as the Tanith were disembarking, 2K began to slide off the dome. While trying to get clear of the ship, Dremmond was injured and fell over, almost sliding off the dome himself. He was saved by [[Trooper]]s [[Brin Milo|Milo]], who caught Dremmond before he fell, and [[Noa Vadim|Vadim]], who pulled them both to safety.{{Fn|3a}}{{Fn|3b}}

Durek.wikitext:
{{otheruses|USE=Imperial Navy captain|OTHERUSE=[[Space Marine]]|OTHERPAGE=Durek (Guardians of the Covenant)}}
{{ImperialNavyPortal}}
'''Durek''' was an [[Imperial Navy]] [[Imperial Navy Captain|Flag Captain]] in [[Jericho Reach|Battlefleet Jericho]], who commanded the [[Battlecruiser]] ''[[Power of Terra]]'' during the [[Age of Apostasy]].{{Fn|1d}}

==History==
Despite serving the [[Imperium]]'s ruler [[High Lord]] [[Goge Vandire]], Durek had sympathy for the rebellious [[Sebastian Thor]]'s [[Thorian|beliefs]]. He also had contacts within Thor's army, the [[Confederation of Light]], which was steadily destroying the strength of Vandire's rule. When his sympathies towards Thor were discovered in 273.[[M36]], an assassin was sent to kill Durek. The [[Imperial Navy Captain|Flag Captain]] escaped, however, and fled aboard the ''[[Power of Terra]]''. He would later encounter [[Mordecai Haarlock]]{{Fn|1d}}, who was leading a rebellion against the [[Jericho Sector]]'s puppet rulers.{{Fn|1c}} Known as the [[Castagar Murella|Over]]-[[Udo Asterus|Governors]], they were lackeys of High Lord Vandire, who ruled the Sector in his name. They also did whatever they could to increase their power and wealth.{{Fn|1a}} This included seizing property, rising the quota-tallies the Sector owed to the Imperium and purging anyone they considered a threat to them.{{Fn|1b}} Their corruption had led Haarlock to begin a rebellion against the Over-Governors' rule{{Fn|1c}} and Durek decided to join him. The Flag Captain then shared his network of contacts within [[Battlefleet Jericho]] and aided Haarlock in forming an alliance with the Confederation of Light.{{Fn|1d}} This greatly aided in the rebellion defeating the Over-Governors{{Fn|1e}} and weakening High Lord Vanidre's rule over the Jericho Sector.{{Fn|1f}}

Dzansk.wikitext:
{{AstraMilitarumPortal}}
'''Dzansk''' was an [[Imperial Guard Captain]] in the [[Cadian 44th Heavy Infantry]] [[Regiment]]{{Fn|1a}}, and had fought to defend the [[Fortress World]] during the [[13th Black Crusade]], until it was destroyed by [[Ezekyle Abaddon|the Despoiler]]{{Fn|1b}}.

==History==
Sometime after the [[Great Rift]]'s creation, the Cadian 44th had been charged with defending [[Kalides Prime]]'s capital [[Dustrious]], but it was later attacked by the [[Death Guard]] [[Chaos Lord|Plaguelord]] [[Morbidius (Plaguelord)|Morbidius]].{{Fn|1a}} The Plaguelord's fleet easily destroyed the [[Imperial Navy]] warships protecting Kalides Prime and then bombarded Dustrious, which wiped out most of the Cadian 44th. Worse still, some of the Death Guard's ordnance had been laced with deadly contagions and those few Guardsmen that had managed to reach safety underground, re-emerged to a city that was ridden with disease. Then the Death Guard Warband of the [[Lord of Contagion]] [[Gurloch]] landed upon Dustrious and the Regiment's [[General]], [[Yorin]], led what remained of the Cadian 44th against the Chaos invaders. Unfortunately, the diseases unleashed by the Death Guard not only sickened the Regiment, but also caused the capital's dead to rise as [[Poxwalkers]], which fell upon the surprised Guardsmen. The Cadian 44th was soon overwhelmed and a thousand Guardsmen were killed by the Poxwalkers, including Yorin and the Regiment's upper command. This led Captain Dzansk to become the Cadian 44th's only remaining officer and he quickly ordered the ragged remnants of the Regiment to retreat, in order to strike back against the Death Guard later.{{Fn|1c}}

After regrouping Dzansk led repeated attacks to harass the Death Guard and break the invaders' bombardment of a force field-protected fortress, which held Kalides Prime's [[Astropathic Choir]]. These attacks did little to disrupt the Death Guard's attempts to seize the fortress and cost the Cadian 44th a high number of lives. Sickened and fighting with rapidly dwindling supplies, the Regiment's end seemed near, until a sign of hope appeared when the [[Ultramarines]] strike force of [[Lieutenant (Space Marine)|Lieutenant]] [[Cassian]] arrived to combat the Death Guard.{{Fn|1c}} 

Dzansk quickly made contact with the Ultramarines and told Cassian what has happened since the invasion began. Afterwards Cassian told Dzansk that a [[Warp Storm]] had driven his strike force's damaged [[Strike Cruiser]] off-course and the Ultramarines needed to reach the besieged Astropathic Choir, in order to inform the [[Indomitus Crusade]] of their location. Dzansk had no idea what the Indomitus Crusade was, but after being informed of its goal and that it was led by [[Lord Commander]] [[Guilliman]], the Captain was left in awe and offered the Cadian 44th's aid to the Lieutenant. Cassian gladly accepted it{{Fn|1c}} and then informed their forces, that he suspected the Death Guard were drawing out the battle as an offering to their [[Chaos God]] [[Nurgle]], as Gurloch's forces had the numbers to simply storm the fortress. The strike force's [[Librarian]] [[Keritraeus]] agreed with this and said he felt the strength of the [[Warp]] increasing in the capital. The Astropathic Choir seemed to be the key to Gurloch's plans and in order to stop the Chaos ritual from succeeding, Cassian stated they most retake the fortress instead of directly fighting the Death Guard. As their forces were vastly outnumber however, Cassian needed the Cadian 44th to stage a diversionary attack on the Death Guard, which would give the Ultramarines the time they needed to enter the fortress. Once they did so, the Ultramarines would send word of Gurloch's plot to the Indomitus Crusade, which would surely arrive with enough forces to destroy the invading Death Guard. Once he heard Cassian's plan though, Dzansk claimed it would cost the sickened Cadian 44th dearly, and they would not survive if the Death Guard attacked them in large numbers. Cassian assured him however, that once the strike force arrived at the fortress, they would hold its gates open long enough for the Regiment to reach safety within its walls. Dzansk agreed to Cassian's plan{{Fn|1d}}, but knew the Cadian 44th's fate was sealed, as they had been immersed within the Death Guard's diseases for too long. They could not risk spreading their sickness to the people within the fortress, nor would the Regiment make it off Kalides Prime alive. None the less, Dzansk rallied the sickened Cadian 44th and roused their weary spirits for one final charge against the Death Guard, for [[Cadia]] and the [[Emperor]]{{Fn|1b}}. 

As he had suspected though, the Death Guard overwhelmed the Cadians and Dzansk knew they had only minutes left at best. The Captain had stood back to organize the Regiment's attack, but he could no longer listen to their death cries and took to the field, after telling Cassian the Cadian 44th would buy the Ultramarines as much time as they could before they fell. He then ordered his [[Chimera]] to charge the Death Guard and fired upon them, until a [[Defiler]] destroyed the vehicle. The resulting explosion sent Dzansk flying from the Chimera's wreckage, and he passed out once he hit the ground. When he awoke, Dzansk was alone and knew he was mortally wounded. Despite this, he forced himself to stand and then grabbed the Cadian 44th's [[Regimental Standard]], before making his way toward the sound of gunfire. Before Dzansk made it though, the Contagion Lord Gurloch appeared and barred his path. Surrounded by his bodyguards, Gurloch easily lifted the battered Captain off the ground and congratulated Dzansk on the Cadian 44th's efforts against his Warband. The Contagion Lord then said he was done with the Cadians and after he killed the Ultramarines, he would be free to spread the plague they created on Kalides Prime, across the stars. By this time Dzansk was near death and lamented that he had no weapon to turn upon the gloating Gurloch - until his hand brushed against the [[krak grenade]]s, attached to his belt. With the last of his strength, Dzansk pulled the pin from one of the grenades, before passing away{{Fn|1b}}. Though one of Gurloch's bodyguards saw what had happened and hurled Dzansk's body away from the Contagion Lord, the resulting explosion killed three of the Death Guard and gravely wounded Gurloch.{{Fn|1e}}

Dzargon Draznicht.wikitext:
{{CrimsonSlaughterPortal}}
[[Image:Draznicht.jpg|thumb|right|Draznicht{{Fn|2}}]]
'''Dzargon Draznicht''' is a member of the [[Crimson Slaughter]].  Once the wisest mind in the [[Crimson Sabres]] before their corruption, he was renowned for his preternatural perception, which caused him to develop a [[Mutant|Mutation]] when his Chapter fell to [[Chaos]].  His mind was opened to the [[Warp]] and a baleful third eye opened upon his forehead, ever seeking new ways to unleash murder.  Now Draznicht follows [[Kranon]] as his right-hand man and [[Chaos Chosen|Chosen]] warrior.{{Fn|1}}

==Biography==
By 928.[[M41]]{{Fn|4a}}, Dzargon Draznicht was the [[First Captain]] of the [[Crimson Sabres]], and was regarded as the most taciturn and reserved member of the Crimson Sabres Sword Council. When the request for help came from [[Umidia]], Draznicht voted in favor of responding. As the fighting dragged on, the Crimson Sabres began to succumb to [[Chaos|Chaotic influence]]. One of Draznicht's own Marines, Sergeant [[Kestalev Chyre]], attacked one of [[Space Marine Captain|Captain]] [[Anzo Reigler]]'s [[Scout]]s for attempting to leave the flight deck before First Company, he ordered the boy to apologize to Chyre, over Captain Reigler's objections. When Reigler went to confront Draznitch, the First Captain was having an argument with the Balethu, the cultists that had been slain.{{Fn|3b}} After Captain Reigler and his squad assisted [[Chief Librarian]] [[Xastus Bannon]] in banishing the [[Lord of Change]] responsible for corrupting the Balethu, Draznitch apologized to Reigler, but also took the time to warn him to be too loyal to old alliances, referring to Captain [[Sevarion Kranon]].{{Fn|3c}} When [[Chapter Master]] [[Sevastus Kranon]] called a vote to censure his brother Sevarion for cowardice, Draznitch voted in favour of censure, and it was [[First Sergeant]] Kohl and Sergeant Chyre, Draznitch's men, who escorted Sevarion Kranon to the cells.{{Fn|3d}}

When the Crimson Sabres ventured into the [[Eye of Terror]], Draznitch continued to lead the First Company, but began to suffer mutations. Draznitch was one of the most extreme, not only unlocking his latent [[Divination]] abilities, but also granting him a third eye in his forehead.{{Fn|4b}} When Chapter Master Kranon expressed the desire to end the curse and make out a life, Draznitch was one of those who agreed. As the Crimson Sabres became the Crimson Slaughter, the First Company changed into the [[Ravagers (Crimson Slaughter)|Ravagers]], now including the [[Chosen (Chaos Space Marines)|Chosen]] and [[Chaos Terminator|Terminators]] of the Crimson Slaughter, with Draznitch no longer Captain of the First Company, but as Champion of the Ravagers.{{Fn|4c}}

Ebzan.wikitext:
{{AstraMilitarumPortal}}
'''Ebzan''' was a [[Trooper]] of the [[Jantine First|Jantine Patricians]] [[Imperial Guard Regiment]]{{Fn|1b}} who served as an aide to [[Colonel]] [[Draker Flense]].{{Fn|1a}}


==Biography==
At one point in the [[Sabbat Worlds Crusade]], the Patricians were deployed on [[Menazoid Epsilon]].{{Fn|1b}} The [[Imperial Guard Regiment|regiment's]] commanding officer, [[Colonel]] [[Draker Flense|Flense]], wanted to avenge a blow to his honour by killing [[Colonel-Commissar]] [[Ibram Gaunt]]{{Fn|1c}} and so assembled a team of five Troopers, including Ebzan, to divert from the main advance and track down Gaunt in a series of tunnels beneath a [[Chaos]] necropolis.{{Fn|1b}}

The Jantines successfully lured Gaunt into an ambush using a wounded [[Tolin Dorden|Dorden]] as bait. There, Flense and Gaunt fought a duel to the death with Gaunt winning. The remaining Patricians tried to kill Gaunt themselves, but a team of [[Tanith First and Only|Tanith]] [[Guardsmen]] arrived in time to kill Ebzan and the others.{{Fn|1c}}

Edermo.wikitext:
'''Edermo''' was a [[Space Marine Lieutenant|Lieutenant]] of the [[Novamarines]], commanding one of the two demi-company's of the [[Chapter]]'s Third Company.{{Fn|1a}}

During the [[Plague Wars]] Edermo took part in the attack on [[Iax]], infiltrating the world to conduct intelligence and having to massacre many Imperial civilians to cover up their presence. He later came into battle with [[Ku'gath]] alongside other Novamarines such as [[Justinian Parris]]. He put up a noble struggle against the [[Great Unclean One]] [[Ku'gath]] before being slain.{{Fn|1b}}
